purpose: HIP runtime and evidence smoke, not training or an optimization claim
layout: independent contiguous arrays, no alias or in-place writes, default stream
inputs: bounded dyadic multiples of 1/64 generated by frozen integer formulas in source
oracle: independent CPU double expression rounded to FP32
tolerance_basis: All bounded inputs and exact alpha=0.5 make each FP32 result exactly representable
nan_inf: not in supported input domain; nonfinite output fails

measurement_protocol.scope: HIP events around 100 launches, excluding transfers and compilation
measurement_protocol.interpretation: Candidate may fail the declared performance criterion; do not relax it

limits: Padding and read-only input checks do not prove absence of all out-of-bounds accesses or races
